captured.method: project-level .grok/hooks/capture.json in a scratch git repo with --trust; no user config modified; runs: grok --trust -p ... --permission-mode bypassPermissions; 4 paid runs (A capture, B deny main, C wasted by spawn_subagent also matching the deny filter, D deny subagent)

session_start.note: does not fire for a subagent's own session

user_prompt_submit.subagentType: present on a subagent's own prompt event (str)

pre_tool_use.subagentType: present (str) when the call is made inside a subagent, absent for main

subagent_start.note: fires in the parent session id; sessionId differs from the subagent's own later events

stop.note: a second stop fires at session end with only reason + stopHookActive (no promptId, no lastAssistantMessage); filter on reason == end_turn

session_end.subagentType: present (str) for a subagent's own session teardown

equalities.main_vs_subagent_sessionId: NOT equal: the subagent's own events carry a new sessionId, equal to subagentId of subagent_start/subagent_stop
equalities.subagent_start_sessionId_vs_main: equal (subagent_start is emitted in the parent session)

deny.format_A: {"decision":"deny","reason":"..."} on stdout, exit 0 (the shoal deny_output format)
deny.format_B_hookSpecificOutput: not exercised (documented by grok 10-hooks.md as equivalent)
deny.also_denied: spawn_subagent when the hook matched its prompt text (confirms PreToolUse deny applies to dispatch)

facts.stop_event: exists; payload above; docs say a hook can block via {decision:block,reason} (not exercised)
facts.subagent_start_event: exists, carries subagentType and subagentId; matcher is the subagent type
facts.dispatch_result: post_tool_use spawn_subagent carries toolResult.subagent_type, subagent_id, turns, tool_calls
facts.nonexistent_role: INCONCLUSIVE: the model substituted applier in most attempts; one reply to a no-such-role-xyz spawn looked like a started generic subagent (no error) - needs a harness-driven re-test
facts.subagent_marker: subagentType on tool/prompt/session_end events inside the subagent; absent on main
facts.adapt_grok_gaps: adapt_grok reads hookEventName/toolName/toolInput/subagentType/promptId - all confirmed present; main shell tool is run_terminal_command (not registered by shoal-grok.json today)
